import calendar
from datetime import date


def next_billing_date(start: date, months_ahead: int) -> date:
    if months_ahead == 0:
        return start
    total_months = start.month - 1 + months_ahead
    new_year = start.year + total_months // 12
    new_month = total_months % 12 + 1
    if new_month <= 0:
        new_month += 12
        new_year -= 1
    max_day = calendar.monthrange(new_year, new_month)[1]
    new_day = min(start.day, max_day)
    return date(new_year, new_month, new_day)
